sentences.en: In August 2024, James Daniels was suiting up for an NFL preseason game.
sentences.zh: 2024年8月，詹姆斯·丹尼尔斯正在为一场NFL季前赛做准备。

sentences.en: Daniels was an offensive lineman for the Pittsburgh Steelers,
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯是匹兹堡钢人队的进攻锋线球员，

sentences.en: and he was signed to a lucrative three-year contract to play with the team.
sentences.zh: 他刚与球队签下了一份丰厚的三年代言合同。

sentences.en: But that day, nobody was talking about Daniels as a player.
sentences.zh: 但那天，没人谈论丹尼尔斯作为球员的表现。

sentences.en: The news media was focused on Daniels because of what he was wearing.
sentences.zh: 新闻媒体关注丹尼尔斯，是因为他的装束。
那是制片人克里斯·贝鲁比。

sentences.en: Daniels was believed to be the first NFL player to sport a new kind of helmet during a game,
sentences.zh: 据信，丹尼尔斯是首位在比赛中佩戴一种新型头盔的NFL球员，

sentences.en: an awkward piece of equipment called a guardian cap.
sentences.zh: 这是一种笨拙的装备，被称为“守护帽”。

sentences.en: A guardian cap is basically an extra layer of padding
sentences.zh: 守护帽本质上是一层额外的衬垫，

sentences.en: that goes around the outside of a traditional football helmet.
sentences.zh: 套在传统橄榄球头盔的外侧。

sentences.en: So you've got your helmet, and then you've got your guardian cap,
sentences.zh: 所以你先戴上头盔，然后戴上守护帽，

sentences.en: and then you've got another layer that you pull down over the guardian cap
that then represents the logos of the team,
the Chargers lightning bolts or the Green Bay G or whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 比如闪电队的闪电标志，或是绿湾包装工队的“G”字，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Noah Cohan is a professor of American culture studies at Washington University in St. Louis,
sentences.zh: 诺亚·科汉是圣路易斯华盛顿大学的美国文化研究教授，

sentences.en: and he's the author of an upcoming book about football helmets.
sentences.zh: 他即将出版一本关于橄榄球头盔的书。

sentences.en: He says the guardian cap looks markedly different from what football fans are used to.
sentences.zh: 他说，守护帽看起来与橄榄球迷们习惯的样子截然不同。

sentences.en: It sort of looks like if you had soundproof padding in the form of a cap
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是你把隔音棉做成了帽子，

sentences.en: and stretched that over your helmet.
sentences.zh: 然后把它撑开套在头盔上。

sentences.en: It's a series of lumps made of foam within a sort of fabric covering
sentences.zh: 它是一系列由泡沫制成的凸起，包裹在某种织物里，

sentences.en: that's then clipped to the outside of the helmet.
The guardian cap is meant to absorb the impact of headshots
sentences.zh: 守护帽旨在吸收头部撞击的冲击力，

sentences.en: and to protect players' brains from concussions.
sentences.zh: 保护球员的大脑免受脑震荡。

sentences.en: Some people hailed the caps as a big step for player safety.
sentences.zh: 有些人称赞这种帽子是球员安全方面的一大进步。

sentences.en: Today, most NFL players are required to wear them during practices,
sentences.zh: 如今，大多数NFL球员在训练时必须佩戴它，

sentences.en: and some players even wear them during NFL games.
sentences.zh: 有些球员甚至在正式比赛中也会佩戴。

sentences.en: But since their introduction, players wearing the guardian caps
sentences.zh: 但自从推出以来，佩戴守护帽的球员

sentences.en: have received a ton of mockery.
The caps make players' helmets look bulbous
sentences.zh: 这种帽子让球员的头盔看起来臃肿，

sentences.en: and disproportionate to the rest of their body.
They make professional athletes look like human bobbleheads.

sentences.en: You look like the Great Gazoo.
